description: This file defines a Go package 'libhoclient' that provides a client implementation for interacting with a host orchestrator service. It includes type definitions, interface declarations, and method implementations for managing virtual devices (CVDs), WebRTC connections, file uploads, and other operations in a remote device management ecosystem.

classes.name: ApiCallError
classes.description: Represents an error that occurs during an API call, including error code and message.

classes.name: ConnectWebRTCOpts
classes.description: Options for configuring WebRTC connections, including local ICE configuration.

classes.name: BuildAPICreds
classes.description: Interface for applying credentials to HTTP requests.

classes.name: AccessTokenBuildAPICreds
classes.description: Implementation of BuildAPICreds that uses an access token and user project ID.

classes.name: HostOrchestratorService
classes.description: Interface defining methods to interact with the host orchestrator service, including device management and WebRTC connections.

classes.name: HostOrchestratorServiceImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of HostOrchestratorService, handling HTTP requests and WebRTC signaling.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns string representation of ApiCallError.

methods.name: ApplyToHTTPRequest
methods.description: Applies credentials to an HTTP request builder.

methods.name: NewHostOrchestratorService
methods.description: Factory function for creating a new HostOrchestratorService instance with the specified URL.

methods.name: ConnectWebRTC
methods.description: Establishes a WebRTC connection to a device, handling signaling and ICE configuration.

methods.name: ConnectADBWebSocket
methods.description: Connects via WebSocket to the ADB endpoint of a device.

methods.name: initHandling
methods.description: Initializes signaling channels for WebRTC connection handling.

methods.name: webRTCPoll
methods.description: Polls for WebRTC messages from the server.

methods.name: webRTCForward
methods.description: Forwards WebRTC signaling messages to the remote server.

methods.name: createPolledConnection
methods.description: Creates a new polled WebRTC connection with the server.

methods.name: WaitForOperation
methods.description: Waits for a long-running server operation to complete.

methods.name: waitForOperation
methods.description: Internal implementation of polling for operation completion with retries.

methods.name: FetchArtifacts
methods.description: Fetches artifacts from the server, waiting for the operation to complete.

methods.name: CreateCVDOp
methods.description: Creates a new CVD operation on the server.

methods.name: CreateCVD
methods.description: Creates a CVD and waits for its operation to complete.

methods.name: DeleteCVD
methods.description: Deletes a specified CVD.

methods.name: ListCVDs
methods.description: Retrieves a list of currently running CVDs.

methods.name: Powerwash
methods.description: Performs a powerwash (factory reset) on a device.

methods.name: Powerbtn
methods.description: Simulates pressing the power button on a device.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops a device.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts a device with a specified start request.

methods.name: CreateSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of a device.

methods.name: doEmptyResponseRequest
methods.description: Helper for executing requests that expect no response content.

methods.name: CreateUploadDir
methods.description: Creates an upload directory on the server.

methods.name: UploadFile
methods.description: Uploads a file with default options.

methods.name: UploadFileWithOptions
methods.description: Uploads a file with specified options, supporting chunked uploads.

methods.name: ExtractFile
methods.description: Extracts a compressed file in a specified upload directory.

methods.name: CreateBugReport
methods.description: Creates a bug report for a device or group and writes it to the provided destination.
